reason: The hypothesis directly restates the findings and proposed mechanism from P1 and P9, which already studied the exact same alloy system (AlCoCrFeNiMoTiBx), the same intervention (boron addition to form TiB2), the same mechanisms (grain refinement, hard dispersoids, passive film stability), and the same predicted outcomes (improved wear and corrosion resistance). The hypothesis merely reframes these reported results as a prediction and adds a generic falsification test, without introducing any new alloy, regime, mechanism, or synthesis of disparate sources.
